title: Meta-Core A/B Symbol Binding
purpose: Bind meta-domain A and B to the core effective action pair while preserving higher-domain rebinding discipline.
binding_meaning: A and B are meta-domain placeholders for the core effective pair and may only be rebound in higher domains with explicit labeling.
preserved_distinctions: meta-domain A/B are not affect-domain participants by default
δα(ℰ>0) remains an action trace and is not collapsed into the effective condition
(ℰ≠0) remains the continuing effective condition and is not collapsed into action
inverse_warning: Higher-domain A/B usages may imply the meta-domain pair, but the higher-domain symbols do not exhaust the core effective binding without explicit traceability.
forbidden_collapses: Do not confuse meta-domain A/B with affect-domain A/B.
Do not treat A_meta and B_meta as settled objects independent of the core effective pair.
Do not define RT from rebinding alone without the core effective pair.
Do not treat the binding as identity equivalence.

rebinding_rules.statement: Affect-domain A/B shall only be introduced after explicit domain declaration and traceable rebinding.
Meta-domain A_meta and B_meta remain reserved for the Memory Tensor RT core binding.
Any affect-domain use of A or B must cite the originating domain definition and may not be inferred from the meta-domain binding alone.
Affect-domain A_affect and B_affect are explicit rebinding targets and may participate in local coupling without altering the canonical meta-core binding.

A_affect.definition: A distinguishable affect-domain participant, orientation, or basin after explicit rebinding.

B_affect.definition: A second distinguishable affect-domain participant, orientation, or basin after explicit rebinding.

relation.meaning: Domain-local coupling or comparison between explicitly rebound affect participants.

governance_constraints: Do not reuse A_affect or B_affect as aliases of A_meta or B_meta.
Do not infer affect-domain coupling from meta-domain binding alone.
Do not alter the canonical RT expression.
